scope: Only newly authored documents and labels in this fixture. No existing user documents, OHR data, Agent 200 questions or held-out labels are included.
generation: Authored in source code; no model API used.
validation: Document hashes and exact quotes are checked with the production parser; this is mechanical verification, not human semantic approval.
split: dev only; no held-out/test split is claimed.
split_isolation: This single small fixture is for functional regression and exploratory comparison. It cannot establish unseen-document generalization or independent test accuracy.
multi_turn_policy: history is preserved, but retrieval_question is an explicit author-provided effective query. These cases test retrieval under a frozen continuation query, not Agent condition-merging accuracy.
scope_policy: Full-corpus cases receive all ten allowed document IDs without a gold-document hint. Two question families also have single-document controls and are not independent samples.
evidence_policy: Labels use source SHA256 plus physical page (null for MD/HTML), actual section path and an exact original quote, never chunk IDs.
answer_policy: Facts with accepted_answers support lexical diagnostics only; successful matching does not by itself establish semantic correctness, completeness or citation support.
unanswerable_policy: The allowed corpus does not provide the requested answer. Related or explicitly nondisclosing passages can be retrieved; refusal must not depend on an empty result set.
known_limitations: Synthetic small corpus, no claim of production representativeness.
Not an OHR or Agent 200-question benchmark.
No OCR, tables, charts or long-PDF coverage.
All semantic labels await human review.
Three follow-up cases use author-provided effective queries rather than testing automatic state merging.
